0.original: This Adarkim warrior has his eyes on a particular kind of flower.

24.original: Slay three purbols and obtain pungent flowers.

25.original: Deliver the pungent flowers to the Adarkim warrior.

48.original: Could I ask for your help? I have no one else to turn to.

49.original: I have searched all over the Azim Steppe for one single flower. Someone told me that it was sold in Reunion, but I have had no luck here either.

50.original: Could you search for this flower for me? It shall not be a dangerous task by any means.

51.original: No. I should not lie, least of all to a visitor to our land. It will be a job fraught with peril.

52.original: For the only way to obtain the flower I require is by slaying a purbol. If you are willing to help, you should be able to find some north of here. Please, slay three of them and bring back their flowers.

53.original: Please, slay three purbols and bring back their flowers.

54.original: Were you able to get three of the flowers?

55.original: Oh my, that stench. Quite ghastly indeed. I suppose I should tell you just why I needed these flowers.

56.original: I belong to the Adarkim, the largest of the Xaela tribes. Recent events have led to me being considered as a future khan.

57.original: The position brings with it much power and pleasures, but by the same token, it has given rise to bitter and bloody rivalries. My older brother was a candidate before me, but after no less than eight attempts on his life, he vanished with nary a trace.

58.original: In his absence, I have risen in the line of succession, meaning <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> am now the marked man. <sigh> I did not ask for this...

59.original: Alas, wishing that it were not so will not stay the daggers in the dark. That is why I sought out these foul-smelling flowers─to ward off would-be assassins. And thanks to your help, I may enjoy a moment's respite.

60.original: In the meantime, I will set about finding a permanent solution to my problem. That is, finding my brother, Adkiragh. Unless I do so, there will be no peace for me...save in death.
